additional_info.subject: RE: ID0387299-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170001959] Charger offline on the customer backend CRM:00641000725
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I hope you're doing well.
We’ve checked the charger on SCB, but unfortunately, it appears to be offline, which limits our ability to troubleshoot remotely.
It would be best to have someone on-site verify the following:
The router is connected to the internet.
The charger is powered.
Please also review the following possible causes for the charger being offline on SCB:
Internet Connectivity
: There may be an issue with the Siemens router, possibly due to the failover function switching the WAN connection from cellular to Ethernet.
Mobile Network Service
: The mobile network may be experiencing issues:
The SIM card might be disabled or expired. Please check that the SIM card is inserted correctly by cleaning it and reinserting it into the XF3 and XF4 routers.
Monthly data limits might have been reached.
Signal strength could have weakened due to changing transmission conditions.
For M2M contracts, ensure IP is enabled.
Backend Issues
: There could be changes on the backend affecting this charger:
Settings may have been updated for the charger.
The OCPP server on the backend may be unavailable.
Teltonika Router Issues
: The following router-related issues may also be contributing:
The router may have switched to an incorrect network (e.g., 3G instead of 4G).
Hardware failure or a software crash in the router.
Once the charger is back online on SCB, we can check the router configuration and other settings through SSH, so please refer to the points above to bring the charger online.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0387299
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
